text: Program Description I. Academic Highlights This interdisciplinary dual-degree program brings together ECUST's internationally recognized strengths in Artificial Intelligence and Finance. Students learn from a distinguished faculty of AI and finance scholars, many of whom lead cutting-edge research in machine learning, financial data science, algorithmic systems, and smart decision-making. The School of Information Science and Technology and the School of Business jointly offer a research-rich environment, supported by state-of-the-art labs—including a National Engineering Laboratory for Big Data and dedicated Research Centers in Financial Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Smart Energy. Designed for the intelligent economy, the program equips students with dual literacy in AI technologies and financial markets. Graduates are prepared to tackle complex, real-world problems at their intersection — from automated trading and risk analytics to AI-driven investment platforms. Leveraging Shanghai's position as a global financial and tech hub, the program emphasizes hands-on, industry-connected learning and a global outlook. All core instruction is delivered in English, with opportunities for international exchange and collaboration. This is not merely a fusion of two disciplines, but a launchpad for future leaders in AI finance, quantitative innovation, and fintech worldwide. II. Educational Objectives This interdisciplinary program aims to cultivate versatile graduates who bridge artificial intelligence and finance. Students will develop strong quantitative and analytical foundations, enabling them to design AI-driven financial solutions, analyze complex market behaviors, and innovate at the intersection of technology and finance. Within five years of graduation, students are expected to: Solve real-world problems at the AI-finance nexus—such as algorithmic trading, risk modeling, fraud detection, and smart investment systems—using state-of-the-art machine learning and financial engineering methods. Work across disciplines collaboratively, leading or contributing to projects that require both computational thinking and financial logic, in multinational corporations, fintech firms, investment banks, or regulatory bodies. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, bridging the gap between AI developers and financial decision-makers in a global context. Act with ethical and professional responsibility, understanding the societal, legal, and economic implications of AI in financial markets, including fairness, transparency, and data privacy. Adapt to rapid change through lifelong learning, staying current with advances in AI, blockchain, quantitative finance, and digital assets, and seizing leadership opportunities in an evolving industry landscape. Graduates are well-prepared for global careers in quantitative analysis, fintech product development, AI-driven trading, financial data science, and technology management, or for pursuing advanced degrees in finance, AI, or related fields. III.Core Courses Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Algorithm, Discrete Mathematics, Algorithm and Data Structures, Database Principles, Software Engineering, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Micro-Economics, Macroeconomics, Financial Market, International Finance, Corporate Finance. IV.Graduation Criterion and Degree 1. Graduation Credit Required: 135. General Courses 17 credits, Disciplinary Courses 23 credits, Specialty Courses 77 credits, Practical Activities and Training Courses 16 credits, Innovation and Entrepreneurship Course 2 credits. 2. Duration: 3 years. 3. Degree Conferred: Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Economics. V.
